description: This file defines the localization settings for the Moment.js library, specifically for the Chinese (Hong Kong) locale ('zh-hk'). It includes definitions for months, weekdays, date formats, relative time, and meridiem handling.

methods.name: meridiemHour
methods.description: Converts the hour based on the meridiem indicator to 24-hour format.

methods.name: meridiem
methods.description: Returns the meridiem string based on the hour and minutes.

methods.name: ordinal
methods.description: Generates ordinal string for dates and periods.
